my_way.title: My Path
my_way.sub_title_text: I began my career as a Technical Support Specialist and have since progressed to designing and building complex, scalable, automated, and distributed systems. My focus is on ensuring a high-quality application lifecycle.

workplaces.name: Russian Project
workplaces.description: As a Technical Support Specialist, I specialized in troubleshooting complex technical issues and delivering clear, step-by-step solutions to users.

workplaces.name: MPO-RUMYANTSEV JSC
workplaces.description: As a System Administrator, I gained hands-on experience with network devices, virtualization systems, and Windows Server environments.

workplaces.name: Kraftway
workplaces.description: Spearheaded the adoption of GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Kubernetes. Subsequently, I successfully migrated the majority of services to Docker containers within the Kubernetes environment with zero data loss. This initiative eliminated development chaos by enforcing DevOps/SRE practices and automating key processes. Additionally, I contributed to building web applications.

workplaces.name: Rostelecom
workplaces.description: I build and maintain highly available and fault-tolerant, distributed platforms that enable products to scale to millions of users.

about_me.title: About me
about_me.text_part_one: I am a DevOps/SRE engineer whose mission is to create infrastructure that not only works but scales predictably and withstands failures with resilience.
about_me.text_part_two: My focus is on designing and implementing highly available Kubernetes platforms and infrastructures that serve as a reliable foundation for business applications.
about_me.text_part_three_part_one: I transform routine operations into automated pipelines where code moves from commit to production without manual intervention, and the entire infrastructure's state is described and versioned in code.

block.title: My approach to work
block.sub_title: A strategy built on a deep understanding of DevOps/SRE culture: where development speed meets operational reliability.

items.title: Infrastructure as Code
items.text: Design infrastructure as code with consideration for SLOs, budget constraints, and security requirements. Conduct capacity planning for horizontal scaling to handle peak loads.

items.title: GitOps & CI/CD
items.text: Automate the entire lifecycle of applications and infrastructure: from provisioning with Terraform and configuration via Ansible, to deployment through ArgoCD, Fleet, or GitLab Runner.

items.title: SRE Practices
items.text: Define SLOs/SLIs for key services. Implement incident response procedures and conduct postmortems to prevent recurring failures.

items.title: Observability & Cost Optimization
items.text: Configure observability stacks for proactive monitoring. Optimize resource consumption of applications in K8s and reduce infrastructure costs.
